gitCommit.subject: Trial: ticket SHOP-1 for a real QA run on the demo shop
gitCommit.body:
Trial: ticket SHOP-1 for a real QA run on the demo shop

The ticket the QA writer gets, and QA verify running on pull requests
into trial branches, so that the trial's pull requests stay off main.
